ig.g: Reshala can be found on the following locations: ====Customs==== With 4 followers: * At the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons. * At the dorms area, either in one of the dorms or in the yard between them. * At the new gas station, either inside or around it. ====Terminal==== With 3 followers: In the medium container ship berths area. Note: Reshala is only 1 of 5 possible bosses to spawn each raid.
